items: AI adoption across Asia is moving faster than workers can re-skill, which helps aging economies ease labor shortages while putting low-skilled jobs at risk in younger, labor-intensive markets.
The roles most exposed involve highly repetitive tasks, low digital literacy and limited access to training, such as factory work, frontline customer support, logistics and retail.
If your AI rollout outpaces your team's readiness, expect lower morale, higher attrition, reputational risk and new tools that go unused or misused.
Build workforce adaptation into your AI roadmap with cross-training, human-in-the-loop workflows and AI literacy as core training, and check that you're up-skilling as fast as you automate.
